title: Recall against ef
summary: Plot recall@10 as the search parameter ef increases, showing where the curve flattens.

accessibility.description: A line chart with ef on the horizontal axis from 1 to the chosen maximum, and recall at ten on the vertical axis from zero to one. The curve rises steeply to about ef 64 and then flattens.
accessibility.keyboard: Left and right arrows move a readout cursor along the curve and announce the ef and recall at that point.
